meta.subject: History
meta.source: Government of Tamil Nadu Higher Secondary First Year History, Revised Edition 2025, English and Tamil editions supplied by the user
meta.question_style: Maximum useful source-grounded bilingual competitive-exam coverage from Unit 16: Mughal and south Indian political conditions, Indian agriculture/manufacturing/merchant networks and Indian Ocean trade; Portuguese, Dutch, French, Danish and English settlements; missionary and printing activity; slave trade; East India Company bases in Madras, Bombay and Bengal; the three Carnatic Wars; Plassey, Buxar and the shift from commercial to territorial power.
meta.quality_policy: Four-option bilingual MCQs grounded in the supplied 2025 textbook. Activities, assignments and low-value procedural material are excluded. Distinct textbook facts are reinforced through direct recall, association, recognition and statement-analysis formats. The chapter's own framing is preserved.
meta.page_reference_note: page_en refers to the printed English textbook page.
